column2: Slow push-in on the tired mother's face as she types on her phone with her thumb, the blue screen light flickers on her face, she pauses and frowns in disappointment, the baby stirs slightly in her arm, subtle handheld feel, quiet night atmosphere.

Slow dolly-in toward the marketing manager as she scrolls through the image-only product detail page on the monitor with a mouse, she sighs and rubs her temple, city lights twinkle softly behind the glass, calm camera movement.

Slow arc camera move around the two brothers at their desk, the older brother with glasses points at the monitor and explains, the younger brother in the lavender hoodie nods and types quickly, monitor light flickers on their faces, they exchange a confident glance and smile.

Extreme macro slow dolly along the nutrition label as the purple scanning laser line sweeps across it, the printed numbers and letters peel off and float upward as glowing particles streaming toward the camera, shallow depth of field, mesmerizing smooth motion.

Slow forward flythrough of the digital space, glowing data cards stream from both sides and merge into the bright floating website which assembles itself panel by panel, small comet lights fly in and dock onto the website, god rays intensify, epic smooth camera motion.

The mother reads her phone and her worried face melts into a relieved smile, she turns to her giggling baby in the high chair and gently touches the baby's cheek, warm morning sunlight, gentle slow push-in.

Slow crane up and push-in behind the two brothers on the rooftop as the sun rises over the Seoul skyline, wind moves their hair and hoodie, the younger brother puts a hand on his older brother's shoulder, they both smile looking at the city, lens flare blooms.
